_comment: CONFIRMED against a live WhatsApp Web session on 2026-08-03 via `node scripts/whatsapp-doctor.mjs`: chatList, searchBox, newChatButton, newGroupButton, participantSearch and participantResults all resolved. participantSearch is a real <input type='text'> that carries data-testid='inputarea' ITSELF and has no child input - which is why earlier guesses at '[data-testid=inputarea] input' and contenteditable variants all missed. The client still clicks and types via the keyboard, so a changed inner structure cannot break it. nextButton, groupSubjectInput and createGroupButton remain candidates: they only render after a participant is picked. Nothing here may match a send/delete/leave control - client.mjs refuses those.
_postingComment: CONFIRMED behaviour on this build (2026-08-03 run): the conversation header's title ATTRIBUTE reads 'click here for group info', not the group name - so the rendered text is read first and WhatsApp's furniture is filtered by plausibleTitle() in post-gate.mjs. '#main header' is listed first for that reason: its innerText begins with the real subject. conversationTitle and messageBox are scoped to #main - WhatsApp's conversation panel - which is the whole safety story. #main exists ONLY while a conversation is open, so a stale selector resolves to nothing rather than to the left pane's header or the search box. An earlier unscoped 'header span[title]' could match the CHAT LIST header and report a title while no chat was open at all. Confirm them on your build with: node scripts/whatsapp-doctor.mjs --open "<an existing group name>".
